evidence.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings

summary: Researchers have released EG-ARSA, an open‑source visual auditing system that leverages expert‑derived criteria to evaluate road safety from imagery. Designed for low‑resource settings, the model aims to automate inspections, accelerate hazard detection, and support safer infrastructure planning.
title: Open AI Model EG-ARSA Enables Expert‑Grounded Visual Road Safety Audits in Low‑Resource Environments
